questions.question: Why should you open CSV files with `newline=""`?
options: It is required for DictReader to detect headers
Otherwise line endings are translated twice, producing blank rows on Windows and breaking quoted fields with newlines
It strips trailing whitespace from every field
questions.explanation: The csv module handles line endings itself. Letting the text layer translate them too causes extra blank rows and mishandles newlines inside quoted fields.

questions.question: Which open mode raises FileExistsError if the file already exists?
questions.explanation: x is exclusive creation. w truncates an existing file and a appends to it.

questions.question: How do you make json.dumps serialise a Decimal amount?
options: Pass a default= function (or a JSONEncoder subclass) that converts Decimal to str or float
questions.explanation: default= is called for any object json cannot serialise. ensure_ascii only controls whether non-ASCII characters like ₹ are escaped.

questions.question: In the atomic write pattern, why is the temporary file created in the same directory as the target?
options: Temporary files cannot be created elsewhere
os.replace is only atomic within the same filesystem, so readers see either the old or the new file, never a partial one
So that the json module can find it
questions.explanation: os.replace is an atomic rename on the same filesystem (and overwrites on Windows, unlike os.rename). Writing, flushing and fsyncing a temp file first means a crash never leaves a truncated target.
